name: Charlie's Machine & Supply
old_description: We offer a full line of new and used fresh cut fruit and vegetable processing equipment. We custom design any size job – from one machine to your complete plant line. Enter anything that describes what you are looking for and we’ll help you find it…
about:
Charlie's Machine & Supply operates from Longmont, Colorado, supplying new and used processing equipment for fresh-cut fruit and vegetable operations. The company does not publish a founding date, but notes that its team brings more than 100 years of cumulative experience in the field. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed.

The firm provides a range of machinery including peelers, wedgers, corers, slicers, washers, dryers, and industrial food processors. It custom-designs solutions from a single machine to complete plant lines. Featured equipment includes the 4-Step Double Wash system, Apple Wedger 101, Carrot/Cucumber Peeler with custom stainless stand, Dual Air Apple & Onion Wedger, Electric Cabbage Corer, 20-gallon Industrial Dryer, Hallde RG-400i and RG-300i food processors, and a Large Vegetable Belt Cutter/Slicer. Over 90 percent of the equipment is manufactured in the United States.

Customers are primarily fresh-cut produce processors and food manufacturing plants seeking peeling, wedging, coring, slicing, washing, and drying systems. The company does not list specific client names or industries beyond fruit and vegetable processing.

Charlie's Machine & Supply emphasizes its CMS Guarantee, citing experience, quality, reliability, and post-sale service as differentiators. The company highlights that over 90 percent of its equipment is U.S.-made and that its service commitment extends beyond the initial sale.
